principles: The app generates the workbook; the app is the only reader. Users edit values, never structure.
Rows are identified by keys, never by position. Sorting, filtering, hiding columns and adding comments are safe.
Every export stores a server-side snapshot so an import can be diffed three ways: export snapshot vs workbook vs current database.

file.units_note: $M; percentages stored as decimals with % format; booleans 0/1; enums as dropdown labels mapped to codes

sheets.name: README
sheets.content: What to edit (yellow cells), what not to touch, how import works, export id and time.

sheets.name: Levers
sheets.layout: one row per input, grouped by lever, one value column per exported scenario

row_actions.new_rows: blank member_key = insert; app assigns key

sheets.name: Corporate
sheets.note: Blank = not used for that year

sheets.name: Overrides
sheets.note: Pin any calculated number; delete the row to unpin

sheets.name: Outputs

sheets.name: _lists

scalar_inputs_columns.note: sha256 of the exported editable cells in the row; fast unchanged-row check

cell_rules.locked_cells: protected (no password by default; tenant setting)
cell_rules.data_validation: min/max from variable_def; dropdown for enum/bool/categorical columns

import_pipeline.name: identify
import_pipeline.do: Read _meta. Check tenant and template_version (minor versions compatible). Load export snapshot by export_job_id. No _meta: foreign mode (2-way diff vs current DB).

import_pipeline.name: parse
import_pipeline.do: Locate sheets and columns by header text; ignore unknown sheets/columns (report them). Normalise '35%', '0.35', blanks, TRUE/FALSE, dropdown labels.

import_pipeline.name: validate
import_pipeline.do: Unknown keys, type, min/max, enum membership, VR01-VR10 cross-row rules, structural edits to locked columns (rejected).

import_pipeline.name: diff
import_pipeline.do: Per cell compare export (E), workbook (W), current DB (D): W=E -> unchanged; W!=E and D=E -> changed_in_excel; W=E and D!=E -> changed_in_app (keep D); W!=E and D!=E and W!=D -> conflict; W!=E and W=D -> already_applied. Rows: new (blank key), deleted (action=DELETE), missing (row removed from sheet -> warn, never delete).

import_pipeline.name: impact preview
import_pipeline.do: Recalculate the affected scenarios with proposed changes (incremental engine). Show delta on hero outputs: net, gap, risk-adjusted net, VP gaps, EPS, share price.

import_pipeline.name: review
import_pipeline.do: UI lists changes grouped by sheet with old -> new, conflicts first. Accept all, accept per row, or resolve conflicts (keep app / take Excel).

import_pipeline.name: apply
import_pipeline.do: One changeset (origin=excel_import), atomic, optimistic check on scenario.version, audit_log rows, new calc_run. Undo = revert changeset.

round_trip_tests: export then import unchanged -> zero changes
sort and filter rows -> zero changes
edit in app after export + same cell in Excel -> conflict
add line item row -> insert with new key
value out of range -> invalid, not applied
delete a row without DELETE action -> warning, no delete
